accountNeeded: Meta developer account and, for Advanced Access, a Meta Business account
agentCan: Draft an App Review submission checklist
approvalWait: Varies by permission and by review round. No single published fixed timeline was confirmed for this guide. Treat any timeline you see elsewhere as unverified unless Meta publishes it for that permission.

blockers.blocker: Reviewers cannot get into the app
blockers.fix: Provide a working test account, clear login steps, and a feature that works without extra setup.

blockers.blocker: Permission requested but not shown in use
blockers.fix: Re-record showing that exact permission in that exact feature, and make a real API call with it before resubmission.
Check legal name, address, phone, and document type against Meta's current Business Verification requirements, and resubmit with a matching document.

blockers.blocker: Team can use it but outside users cannot
blockers.fix: That is Standard Access. You still need Advanced Access and App Review for outside users.

checklist.item: 1024 by 1024 icon, privacy policy URL, terms URL, category, and contact are complete
App connected to a verified business, for Advanced Access
Every permission listed is actually called by the code
At least one successful API call per permission, recent
Use case description written per permission
Screen recording per permission, showing it in use
Test account reviewers can use, with access to the feature
Data handling answers prepared, if Meta asks them

cost: Free to register. Business documents and any legal costs are separate and vary.
difficultyWhy: Public use requires Advanced Access for each permission, plus Business Verification, use case descriptions, and screen recordings that reviewers actually test.
humanMust: Create the app and Business account
Submit for App Review and reply to reviewers
managedAppNote: If a managed directory already covers the Meta permissions you need, use it first. Register your own app when you need your own permissions, Pages, or Instagram business access.
name: Meta
nextStep: Complete Basic settings and start Business Verification early, then list only the permissions your code actually calls.
notVerified: Exact current Meta App Review timeline, which was not confirmed from an official Meta page in this check
Exact current Meta dashboard layout and document list
Whether a specific permission requires Business Verification in your case
setupTime: 3 to 6 hours for basic setup, plus 1 to 5 days to prepare a clean App Review submission

steps.blockerTip: Meta shows the privacy policy URL to users in login dialogs. A dead or mismatched policy URL is an easy rejection.
steps.detail: Create an app, add a 1024 by 1024 icon, privacy policy URL, terms URL, category, app purpose, and a primary contact.
steps.title: Create the app and complete Basic settings

steps.blockerTip: Start Business Verification early. It can block Advanced Access even if your code is ready.
steps.detail: Connect the app to a verified business. Business Verification checks legal name, address or phone, and supporting documents, depending on the path Meta shows you.
steps.title: Connect a Business account and complete Business Verification

steps.blockerTip: Every permission requested from an outside user needs Advanced Access and App Review. Do not request a permission you do not actually call.
steps.detail: Add only the products you need, for example Facebook Login or Instagram, and list the exact permissions your code calls, for example pages_show_list or instagram_basic, depending on your feature.
steps.title: Add products and permissions, one permission at a time

steps.blockerTip: Reviewers test the app itself. If they cannot get in, or cannot see a permission in use, that permission can be rejected.
steps.detail: Before submission, make at least one successful API call with each permission you will request, within the recent window Meta requires. Keep a record of what you called.
steps.title: Make a real API call with each permission

steps.blockerTip: A generic app tour is not enough. Show the specific permission, in the specific feature, end to end.
steps.detail: For each permission, write a clear use case: why you need it and how it is used in the app. Record a screen recording showing that permission in use, with a test account reviewers can use.
steps.title: Prepare use case descriptions and screen recordings

steps.blockerTip: Standard Access is automatic for your own team, but it does not allow requesting permissions from outside users. Do not mistake team access for public approval.
steps.detail: Submit Permissions and Features for review. If one permission is rejected, fix only that permission and resubmit it. Do not resubmit unchanged.
steps.title: Submit for App Review and respond per permission

tested: Docs read on 2026-10-31 from third party guides summarizing Meta App Review, not from Meta official docs directly in this check. No Meta developer sign-in, app creation, or App Review submission was completed for this guide.

timeline.note: Start early. Document and contact checks can add rounds.
timeline.wait: Varies, days in many cases, not confirmed as a fixed number here

timeline.note: Treat as unknown until Meta responds. A clean submission with real calls and recordings moves faster.
timeline.wait: Varies by permission and review round, not confirmed as a fixed number here

timeline.note: Fix the exact issue, re-record if needed, and resubmit that permission.

verificationStatus: Third-party only, official timeline not confirmed, no sign-in test
